name: The First Bad Commit

authors.name: Operation Coinnectar Crew (HaxNation x FOSS Mumbai 2026)

description:
The Coinnectar compromise did not happen all at once — a long-trusted external contributor landed it through ordinary-looking pull requests. One of those commits is where the supply chain actually broke.

Walk the full history of the public repository and find the point of origin. Submit the full 40-character commit SHA.
hints: Several late commits add 'features' to different layers of the library. Read the diffs by author date, not the messages.
Three of the suspicious changes lean on something a fourth one introduced first.
